summary: A matching platform built around food, lifestyle and local discovery rather than swipes alone.
challenge: Before TDM, the business needed more than a standard dating app. The goal was to create a modern platform that connects people through shared lifestyle interests, food preferences, location, and local experiences.
approach: TDM developed an interactive dating app with an advanced cuisine and location-based matching algorithm, rich media profiles, and local discovery features for restaurants, jobs, and events. The result was a unique dating ecosystem that blends social connection with real-world lifestyle planning.

results.label: Easier app management through admin panels

testimonial.quote: TDM built a unique dating app experience that goes beyond matching and helps users connect through lifestyle, food, and local discovery.
